'''Alexander Knyazev''' (born 19 July 1976) is a Russian [[Crystal chemistry|crystal chemist]] and [[Physical chemistry|physical chemist]], Professor of the [[Lobachevsky University]], Dean of the Chemical Faculty.<ref>{{Cite web|title = УНЦ "Химия": Руководство|url = http://www.unn.ru/chem/leadership.php|website = www.unn.ru|access-date = 2016-01-24}}</ref> Head of the Department of [[Medicinal chemistry|Medicinal Chemistry]], Head of the postgraduate research school "New materials based on inorganic compounds." He graduated from the Faculty of Chemistry, Lobachevsky University  (1998) and PhD (2000), Doctor of Chemistry (2009),<ref>{{Cite web|title = Князев Александр Владимирович - Диссертации - Известные ученые|url = http://www.famous-scientists.ru/list/3306|website = www.famous-scientists.ru|access-date = 2016-01-24}}</ref> academic rank of professor (2011).

== Biography ==

Author of more than 280 articles in national and international academic journals,<ref>{{Cite web|title = Alexander Knyazev E-7898-2013 - ResearcherID.com|url = http://www.researcherid.com/rid/E-7898-2013|website = www.researcherid.com|access-date = 2016-01-24}}</ref> three chapters in books and three textbooks. H-index 18 ([[Web of Science]]). Deputy Chairman of the Conference RCCT-2015.<ref>{{Cite web|title = RCCT-2015 {{!}} Nizhni Novgorod 22–26 June 2015|url = http://www.rcct2015.unn.ru/|website = www.rcct2015.unn.ru|access-date = 2016-01-24|archive-date = 2019-03-20|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20190320042110/http://www.rcct2015.unn.ru/|url-status = dead}}</ref> 12 post-graduate students defended their Ph.D. theses.

== Research interests ==

* [[Crystal chemistry]]
* Chemical [[thermodynamics]] Inorganic and organic compounds
* [[Radiochemistry]]

== Membership in leading scientific communities ==
* Chief editor of the journal "Applied Solid State Chemistry"
